value: Helps veterans in San Antonio, Texas find restaurants offering free or discounted meals on Veterans Day (Wednesday, November 11, 2026), plus year-round community food help.

Offers and participation vary by location and can change without notice. Call to confirm before you drive, and bring military ID or other proof of service. This unofficial directory is not affiliated with the listed restaurants, the U.S. Department of Veterans Affairs, or the Department of Defense.
